# Al-Abbasy Paints (العباسي للدهانات)

> Authorized KAPCI paints dealer in Cairo, Egypt since 1999. Paint shop (محل بويات ودهانات) with two branches: Nasr City and New Cairo (Fifth Settlement). Sells the full KAPCI Coatings range plus LATICO and REFINIX, with computerised colour matching using the KAPCI PRIMA car-refinish system. Delivery service and stocked warehouses.

## Facts
- Name: العباسي للدهانات / كابسي العباسي / Al-Abbasy Paints / El Abbasy Paints (Google Maps listings: "كابسي العباسي" Nasr City, "كابسي العباسي للدهانات كابسي التجمع" New Cairo)
- Website: https://abbasypaints.com/
- Founded: 1999 · Manager: Belal Abbas (بلال عباس)
- Authorized dealer (وكيل معتمد) of KAPCI Coatings (كابسي)
- Branch 1 — Nasr City (مدينة نصر): 10th District, Saqr Quraish, Block 41, Building 7. Phone 02 24090094, WhatsApp/mobile 01005645742
- Branch 2 — New Cairo, Fifth Settlement (التجمع الخامس): 1000 Factories Area, Factory 111. WhatsApp/mobile 01098559118
- Services: car paint mixing & colour matching (PRIMA 8700 Primabase, 8600 Primacryl, spectrophotometer), any colour on request (RAL and custom), delivery

## Products
- Car refinish paints (دهانات سيارات / بويات سيارات): primers, putty, fillers, basecoats, clearcoats, thinners, hardeners, polishing
- Building / decorative paints (دهانات مباني): LATICO and KAPCI emulsions, sealers, special effects
- Wood coatings (دهانات أخشاب): nitrocellulose, polyurethane, polyester, water-based, stains (WS100, WS200)
- Industrial coatings and resins (ريزين)
